items.note: S2.3 states Lemma lem:scalar-motifs (forward invocation y_S <- y_S + x_S for arbitrary scratch, three stages give (X_a,Y_a) -> (-Y_a,X_a) with every auxiliary value restored), and S2.3.4b-d and S2.3.5 follow the proof at 741-765: net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 or (|S cap T|-1)/2 cancelled by the side injection, then the three-stage composition. The plan never gives h=100, the neighbour counts or the wire-count formulas eq:bit-wire-count/eq:complex-wire-count (767-783); it only says the counts are fixed. The lemma itself does not need them.

Frames D_v, edge operator D_v D_u^{-1}, and the invariant proof (sources by definition, edges, linearity at gates) giving D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, exactly as at 804-825.

The plan covers the bilinear forms and the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines, the terminal labels, the stage transitions, the eight-time label table, the residual table, the 2->5 inclusion, the telescoping to Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, the orthonormal bases over F_2, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539, following the proof at 1012-1103. The plan never defines I, c, h=100 or N, so the stated ratios cannot be recomputed from it; the paper also just states them (1105-1109). S2.5.5b's paraphrase slightly misstates one residual (see errors).

Projections P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at the X_a sources, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N exceptional source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m with deficit N-2L_b, and the endpoint identity P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m. This matches proof 1156-1172.

The phase frames C_U, weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, the odd weight of norm-one vectors giving one kernel aI+bX_v per residual basis vector, the count s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c with deficit 2N-2L_c, the k-column tensoring, the 27-coordinate C^{-1} on X_a->Y_a repaired by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}, and the sign correction are all present. They follow 1231-1315.

Both s_b<W_b m and s_c<W_c m are stated, with L/N<1/2 and the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c. The plan gives the exact eta_b=339/22587335000000 and eta_c=73/19906842167500, both above 20*2^{-50}, then log m<20 and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta), so s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. This is the paper's route at 1319-1346. The eta values are quoted, not computed, as in the paper.

The O(V) digit operations, the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, and the controlled cyclic shift (split at Q-a, merge reversed, b^C=O(Q) absorbed) are stated and derived as at 513-527 and 574-590. The plan's statement of the controlled-shift lemma omits multiplication of y by a fixed rational unit and its inverse (569-570). S2.8.5 still relies on that operation ('multiply by its diagonal unit'). Its proof (592-614), and the counter and setup accounting (529-549), are missing.

The plan gives the reversed-Bruhat elimination (topmost row, rightmost entry, lower triangular operations, exactly a ones) and the O(V) lower triangular transforms. It then gives the conjugation E_2, E_1^{-1}, Pi, E_1, E_2^{-1}, and the three-update realisation of H_i <- H_i+D_j with one interchange, so the call count equals the rank a. This is 1375-1447. The choice of the odd prime avoiding denominators (1413-1423) is only summarised in S2.8.4.

The contract eq:finite-shear-contract, the cyclic split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} implemented recursively by the shear lemma, the frame identity giving Phi_{I_m}, the merge undoing rho, and the interchange by three shears are all here. So are the s calls, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric-sum solution F_k=O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule. This follows 1491-1616.

rho high digits as row field with R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to R'<2R, the base-m split with sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(e^tau), removal of the padding, padding [2^u] to [q^e], and the one-bit unequal-width case are all present. This is the proof at 1649-1762.

The plan conjugates by P_M so that the residual directions become coordinate kernels (eq:phase-edge-coordinate), giving one child (C^{eps})^{tensor f} per slot. Inverses use (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, and there are at most m(m-1)+3m row additions done by the packed operation. The plan covers: the eight conditional additions restoring w (the two three-cycles); the segments with guards; each line as one cyclic shift; the bad set with twenty excluded guard values and delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}; T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting only B; repair by extraction and radix sort; the top position by a two-bit XOR; the cost terms; and the use for row additions. The plan has node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0 preprocessed chunks as the row index padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, and the row split giving V/W children. It has F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with F(e)=O(e) below d^beta and K <= e^{c/beta}, internal sum O(e^lambda), leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}). Character cancellation by the shift k -> k+t/2^{v+1}, decimation in frequency into bit-reversed order B_t, reverse traversal giving F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, and a round as parallel H then J_E are all present. So are the prefix-slot moves, at most Dq-1 width-K chunk exchanges giving pK^{tau-1}, the common offset (h-b) mod K, monomial splitting, one truncation per round (error < sqrt2 l 2^{-p}), and the LBF^- / F^+B^{-1}L^{-1} identification. The plan omits the round schedule (3058-3069) and the descriptor bound, which are not essential. S3.9 misstates the per-round cost (see errors).

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p} with signed carries, four products by the Harvey-van der Hoeven multiplier, |h_j| < B_0/2, centered-residue extraction with the residual-identity induction, negacyclic wrap with |H_j| <= r 2^{2p}, and truncation to Q_p(fg/r) in O(rp log(rp)) are all here. The plan gives all fixed rationals (tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, lambda, c, lambda', epsilon, delta, kappa) and checks the layer conditions. It sets b, p=6b, d, K, T, r, t_i with Tp=Theta(n), and alpha, gamma <= b/4, eta=1/(4d). The plan has the cost table divided by V=Tp, the seven margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=epsilon c(1-tau)=2^{-181}=2 kappa, and per-row justifications. Setup, per-record work and exceptional sorting are o(Tp), and log factors are absorbed by p^kappa. This gives O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}), with schoolbook multiplication below the cutoff. It follows 4810-4995.

S0 asserts that the bound 'disproves the n log n optimality conjecture in this model' and S1 recalls the conjecture. No step states what an eventual lower bound means (T_A(n) >= c_A n lg n for n >= N_A) or that one machine with liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 refutes it (381-387).

errors.says: The at most b+1 <= K prefix-slot rounds process their participating bits individually 'at cost O(Tp) per round and O(TpdK) in total'.
errors.paper: Each participating bit is processed individually: it is moved next to the polynomial suffix, paired and scanned, at O(Tp) for its moves and scans. A round has up to D <= d participating bits, so it costs O(TpD), and the b+1 <= K rounds give O(TpdK). O(Tp) per round would give only O(TpK) and does not match the stated total.

errors.says: The residual table gives, 'for example', 'h on each central edge'.
errors.paper: The first central edge source->1 has residual B tensor F of dimension (a-1)h. Only the edges 1->3, 3->4 and 4->6 have dimension h.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. S2 builds the two power-saving tape procedures from the rank-saving network: frames, labels, the rank budget, the bit and phase interfaces, the shear factorization, and the two recurrences with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. S3-S5 build synthetic transforms, the ring convolution, Gaussian resampling with kept permutations, and the chirp/permutation cancellation. S6 fixes parameters, assembles the algorithm, proves exact recovery and totals the cost to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). It thins out in three places. The fixed network's sizes (h=100, v, N, m, I, c, W_b, W_c) are never stated, so L/N=100/539 and the deficits eta are quoted rather than traceable. The stream-primitive statement omits the unit scalings that S2.8.5 uses. The final refutation of the n log n conjecture is only asserted in S0.

steps.note: The network's mechanism is fully present: copy, side, gather and scatter gates on triples, the bank exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), and restoration of every scratch wire. But h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never stated. N and m are used undefined, and h=100 appears only implicitly through the quoted eigenvalue -91/9. Since part of the required content is missing, the conservative verdict is mentioned.

The plan has the common invertible frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate by linearity, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the edge cost D_v D_u^{-1}. Its motivation says intermediate frames are free and chosen so each edge is cheap.

The plan has nondegenerate labels in F^{tensor 3} of dimension m built from triple indicators, orthogonal for neighbours, and every edge joining comparable labels. The only decreasing edges are the central 3->4 edges, each losing h.

The plan has rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate U in V, so an edge's rank is its dimension change. The N exceptional source edges 2P_{U_a} have rank one where the dimension change was zero.
The plan has the sum of absolute dimension changes Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, from telescoping at gates and terminal sums N and Wm-N, and adding the N source ranks gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
The plan has L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, and the deficits N-2L_b>0 (bit) and 2N-2L_c>0 (complex), so s<Wm. The ratios are quoted, not computed, as in the paper.

The plan has M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m for every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m on X_a, zero and identity elsewhere). Through Phi frames this gives f'_{rho(w)}=Phi_{I_m} f_w, the shear H <- H+D on every role including scratch rows.
The plan factors A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, giving exactly a interchanges plus O(V). Each interchange is a recursive call, so the node makes s=sum of ranks calls on V/W streams.
The plan has children of volume V/W and F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). With eta > 20*2^{-50} and log m < 20 it gets s/W < m^tau for tau=1-2^{-50}, and the geometric sum gives F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan rebuilds the chain from frames through labels, rank equals dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N<1/2, the endpoint shear and the edge-as-calls factorization to the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. Eight of nine steps are reconstructed. C1 is only mentioned: the exchange network's mechanism is there, but h=100, N and m are never defined, so the quoted ratios 100/539 and eta cannot be traced from the plan.
